q2_publishability.reason: This is a rigorous route audit and counterexample to a proposed interface, not a new ordinal partition relation or a proof/disproof of the open case.

new_rigorous_results: Exact successor pushout obstruction: two or more independently appended child histories cannot be merged while preserving every locally correct child-index label.
The source Case 4 and Case 5 precedence constraints each have a unique ordered replay, respectively TU<SU<ST and ST<SU<TU.
T(omega) limit-root labels encode ranks below the root, while T(3) successor-root labels encode actual child indices; blind substitution changes the interface.
For finite Gamma subset omega, every locally Gamma-free T(omega) family has empty root labels.

Consequently a single finite-Gamma-free T(omega) builder family cannot retain positive-root pair histories. This blocks the literal root-coded transplant but does not block a redesigned empty-root finite-rank builder branch.
A trace map satisfying the required order-type preservation is a Galvin--Larson pinning map, so constructing it is solution-level rather than a routine compression.
first_strict_breakpoint: Build and prove an ordered, strategy-aware T(3) replay lemma that preserves actual child indices, convex partition nodes, critical/decision nodes, completion barriers, conservative bounds, and final clear coarsenings.
additional_builder_breakpoint: Reprove the builder branch with empty T(omega) roots and signals at ranks 1,2,3, or work directly on T(3); the finite-Gamma root guard shows the original root-coded family cannot be reused verbatim.
next_decidable_action: Formalize one source schedule on T(3) and either prove the first two-game ordered replay step including Definition 10.19 partition nodes, or exhibit its first strategy-dependent counterexample.
claim_guard: The guards refute only symmetric union and a literal positive-root finite-Gamma transplant. They do not refute ordered replay or an empty-root redesign, and they do not decide Erdős #592.
